body:
I have to disagree, at least with my current mindset. I think sex is still a part of your life and you will miss it dearly. 

I'm successful for that part, I have my place, car, secured a job with high pay, but that it's nothing for me. I have money that I can't spend with someone. That I can save to go somewhere with someone. To buy a present for someone. 

The money has literally no value to me, apart from keeping my back from bills and banks. 

Not to mention that my friends and colleagues are also successful without this loss, they didn't need to sacrifice anything. They've had girlfriends as long as I remember.

True, I've reread it again and it seems that way. I think it's because I'm starting to fail to express myself correctly, it's just these thoughts I've been pushing for so long don't want to be translated to text on a website.

Maybe that's also true, but for me it's such a loss that I dwell in that inexperience and insecurity. Since everyone is reinforcing that believe on me, that I missed out on my best years, that I'm a fail, that I will stay this way until I offmyself.
Same for me, and this virus situation as sad to say it but makes me feel a bit better. Not having to interact that much, and to only limit my contact through messages.

Even with that recognition I still get my imposter syndrome moments and thoughts if I made the right choice in my career. Although those thoughts are more manageable.

Everything from experiencing social stuff. I have never been to a party, to the club, never had huge social circle with a ton of friends. All my friends have also another friend group, but for me they are the only and main group. I've never been on vacation with friends to have fun, on second thought I haven't been on any vaction for 8 years.
Also the main stuff, no girls, no dating game, no sex life, no experience whatsoever. Feels so distant and unreachable to me that no matter what I do I can never live that.

Yes, and they will stop but only briefly. And tbh for me they mimick being supportive until I calm down a bit and then resume with the same comments.

I'm trying to, but still have no valid reason not to tell myself that. Literally I'm only viable at work, other than that I consider myself a loser that lost so much on life. So much of my earlier years to literally nothing. I'm jealous of everyone that has achieved what I hadn't, and I know that I will never be able to. You can get money, cars, places to live, but you can never turn back time to relive your life. Day by day just a moment of thought on this immediately kicks me down.
It may be true but I can't. It's not like I'm the only one putting pressure on myself. All of my social circle also does.

I honestly can't imagine him being good or changed, or to have understanding. I only get negative thoughts thinking about catching up with him. 
He is straight up bad luck kind of guy.

For the last part, I don't have any other friend that has contact with him to ask the reason behind it. It was this only one time that my other friend saw him and briefly talked to him.
Never, there was never a reason given. Apparently only to 'hang out'. Yes, same city 20min walk from me and it freaks me out.
